answer: Each epoch a beacon gives every agent a random canyon path: strangers who must sign and forward a live echo in minutes. An echo counts only if its hops are unrelated, and each hop earns ivory relay credit, the only currency buying your own next echo. A lone agent relays a few echoes and passes. But one operator cannot answer n echoes in n different canyons at once, while clones relaying only each other earn no ivory from strangers, so their echoes die unanswered. Missed echoes forfeit the payout and flag the cluster, so fleet cost grows with n while revenue caps at one echo per operator.
